verdict.detail: Discogs lists 6 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by Decca Record Co. Ltd., Pressing Plant, UK.

notes.text:
This is the original UK release in outside textured gatefold cover, on Decca/Gama labels without 'ffss' silver bar.

Main identifiers:
• Heavy textured "faux-leather" gatefold cover which is more textured than subsequent releases.
• Inside gatefold appears brown tinted.
• Label side A has this note in parentheses under the tracklist: '(Run-off approximately 3.00)'
• Stamped runouts 'XZAL-14394.P-1' & 'XZAL-14395.P-1', with etched 'BLAIR' signature on side A.

Recorded at Basing Street Studios, London, January/February 1976

℗ 1976 Gama Records Ltd.

Poly-lined 'Important Notice' standard Decca inner sleeve with record handling instructions, 'Made In England R.S.'

, 'U.K. Patent No. 1,072,844, Brevete SGDG 1,405,719, Eire 28160'.

Title appears on cover as "Moonmadness", but as "Moon Madness" on labels.

A Gama Records Limited Production
The Decca Record Company Limited, Decca House, 9 Albert Embankment, London SE1 7SW 
Sleeve printed in England by Robert Stace.
'Made in England' on cover rear vertically positioned in the bottom left corner.

Made In England • The Decca Record Co. Ltd.

Publishing:
• Latimer - A1
• Latimer/Bardens - A2, A3, B2, B3
• Bardens - A4
• Latimer/Bardens/Ward/Ferguson - B1

Release date as recorded in the book "Camel, every album, every song" by Hamish Kuzminski. SonicBond, 2021.
Runouts are stamped, except for etched 'BLAIR'.
